changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwgeneralassessment AS SELECT ga.id, ga.patient_id, ga.encounter_id, ga.position_status, ga.body_movements, ga.level_of_consciousness, ga.facial_expression, ga.speech, ga.mood_behavior, ga.memory_remote, ga.memory_recent, ga.signs_of_agitation, ga.signs_of_depression, ga.signs_of_suicidal_ideation, ga.signs_of_substance_use, ga.is_triage, ga.created_by, ga.created_date, ga.last_modified_by, ga.last_modified_date FROM public.general_assessment ga;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwgeneralassessment TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwgeneralassessment FROM report_user;
